name: cut dry oak limb
description: a large, cut, dry limb with light gray bark
details: A large oak limb, cut cleanly from the trunk at its base.  Its bark is light gray and scaly, its twigs are reddish-brown and hairless, and small, blunt, reddish-brown buds cluster at the twig tips.  It lacks leaves, having been dead long enough that they've browned and fallen off, and the bark has begun to loosen from the dry wood.
keywords: cut dry oak limb cut limb dry limb large limb light gray scaly bark reddish-brown hairless twigs blunt reddish-brown buds dry wood
